author: ramelow
quote:
The biggest issue for me is the pacing and overall feel of the game. It doesn’t feel like a classic Grand Theft Auto. It feels much closer to an improved Red Dead Redemption 2 — slow, immersion-heavy, full of everyday activities and “chores.” There’s a strong life-sim vibe running through it, almost like The Sims mixed with Rockstar’s usual open world. After waiting this long, I expected more chaos and freedom, not something that feels this controlled and deliberate.
The dual-protagonist system with Jason and Lucia is another major problem for me. The game puts a lot of focus on Lucia, and the relationship system feels very one-sided. Jason is heavily restricted — he has to stay loyal, buy her gifts, and basically play the supportive boyfriend role, while Lucia seems to have more freedom in how she acts. A lot of people online are already calling it a “cuck simulator,” and I can see why that reaction exists. It doesn’t feel like the classic GTA freedom where you could do whatever you wanted.
